mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at 55 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park with clear skies and a first quarter moon overhead, though there are no visible ISS sightings in our area tonight.

The city wants to keep you informed through the VHAT cable channel and our official city blog, where you can find meeting summaries and project updates. Also, remember to stay compliant with our local parking codes regarding vehicles and recreational equipment storage.

We have a busy schedule today with yoga at Insight Wellness, live music at the Concerts in the Park series, and trivia night at Hop Haus Brewing Co. Looking ahead, tomorrow brings live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly police report, on July 15, officers responded to a domestic disturbance call on Prairie Oaks Drive, which led to an arrest for felony bail jumping.
Today's flavor is Really Reese's. Culver's is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM today.
